name: Artifacts
summary: Artifacts are documents, decks, designs, dashboards and small interactive tools that Claude creates in a panel beside the chat, where they can be edited, revisited and shared. Artifacts can call Claude using each viewer's own account, connect to the viewer's apps, and store data between sessions.
facts: Free, Pro, Max, Team and Enterprise plans; also in Claude Code
Docs, Slides, Design; Dashboards and Motion in beta
Use the viewer's Claude plan; no API key, no cost to the creator
Personal or shared, 20 MB text per artifact
Private by default, shared by link permissions
goodFor: Turning a conversation into a shareable document or tool
watchOut: Tied to Claude accounts and plans
Shared storage is visible to every viewer
Older chat artifacts became legacy in September 2026
